nodes.label: limit + 1 has-more
nodes.rationale: Fetch pageSize+1; if the extra row arrives there is another page, then slice it off. Measured 2.10 ms vs 2.11 ms for the plain page — free and exact. Cannot render Page 1 of N. Classic bug: forgetting to slice so the last page returns 21 items.

nodes.label: Exact count(*)
nodes.rationale: A second query returning the exact total. Measured 48.83 ms vs 2.11 ms for the page (~23×) over 125000 matching rows. Scales with matches; the page stays bounded by LIMIT. Required only for a numbered pager.

nodes.label: count(*) OVER ()
nodes.rationale: One-query total. Measured 152.77 ms — three times a separate count(*). WindowAgg must see every matching row before emitting the first, so LIMIT cannot stop early.

nodes.label: WindowAgg defeats LIMIT
nodes.rationale: count(*) OVER () is unknown until the last matching row. Plan showed WindowAgg actual rows=125000 feeding a Limit of 20. You pay a full scan and carry the total on every returned row.
